Subpart W—Rollover Protective Structures; Overhead Protection Authority: 40 U.S.C. 3701 ; 29 U.S.C. 653 , 655 , 657 ; and Secretary of Labor's Order No. 12-71 ( 36 FR 8754 ), 8-76 ( 41 FR 25059 ), 9-83 ( 48 FR 35736 ), 1-90 ( 55 FR 9033 ), 6-96 ( 62 FR 111 ), 3-2000 ( 65 FR 50017 ), 5-2002 ( 67 FR 65008 ), or 1-2012 ( 77 FR 3912 ), as applicable. § 1926.1000 Scope. ( a ) Coverage. This subpart applies to the following types of material handling equipment: All rubber-tired, self-propelled scrapers, rubber-tired front-end loaders, rubber-tired dozers, wheel-type agricultural and industrial tractors, crawler tractors, crawler-type loaders, and motor graders, with or without attachments, that are used in construction work.
